instruction: Candid outdoor photograph of four friends sitting on a green grassy lawn in a park. From left to right, the Asian man in the red 'T' shirt (R3) sits smiling; the woman in the dark blue 'E' shirt (R4) sits next to him looking towards the center; the Black woman with an afro in the red 'A' shirt (R6) sits cross-legged gesturing with her left hand; and the bald man in the blue 'M' shirt (R2) sits on the far right looking back at her with a smile. The background is a lush green park under soft, natural daylight.
elements: R6 is the active hand-gesturing participant while R2 looks back at her smiling
R6 gestures with her left hand while R4 looks toward the center rather than gesturing
R2 sits and directs his attention back toward R6
the group is seated on a green grassy lawn in a park

questions.q: Is R6 the one gesturing with her left hand while R2 is the one looking back at her with a smile, rather than R2 gesturing while R6 looks back?

questions.element: R6 gestures with her left hand while R4 looks toward the center rather than gesturing
